result.title: Dynamical Batching: How Class-Cycling Training Shapes the Internal Structure of Neural Networks
result.comment: 18 pages, 10 figures, 5 tables. Code: https://github.com/samuellozanoiglesias/dynamical_batching (archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23349474)
result.summary: We investigate whether cyclically varying the class composition of training batches can modify both the performance and the internal organization of neural networks. Motivated by nonequilibrium systems, in which cycling between related sub-goals can make switching between their solutions increasingly efficient, we introduce Dynamical Batching (DB), a sampling protocol that periodically emphasizes each class while leaving the loss and the optimizer unchanged, and compare it with Uniform Batching (UB), in which every mini-batch has equal class proportions. In the regime where standard training fails, DB changes the outcome: on a three-arm spiral, a capacity-limited MLP that plateaus far below perfect accuracy under UB fits the training data under DB. Tracking individual weights, we find that under DB the change between class-specialized states is carried by a smaller set of weights than under UB, and that this set is markedly more persistent from cycle to cycle, on every synthetic dataset we test and in a wider network that fits the data under both protocols. This organization is a signature of the protocol rather than a predictor of its benefit: it appears equally where DB leaves accuracy unchanged. On CIFAR-10, the same protocol modestly improves the test accuracy of a channel-narrowed ResNet-10, a standard residual architecture, and of a second capacity-limited convolutional network. These results show that how class emphasis is distributed in time can shape both the solution a network reaches and the internal structure of the network.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 Dynamical Batching（DB）：在不改动损失与优化器的前提下周期性改变每个 mini-batch 的类别组成，考察其能否改变网络的性能与内部组织；结果显示 DB 能让原本受容量限制、在均匀采样下停滞的 MLP 拟合数据，并使类别特化状态之间的切换由更少且更稳定的权重子集承担，在 CIFAR-10 上也有小幅测试精度提升。
AI.relevance_reason: 该文探讨训练期时间维度的类别强调如何塑造内部状态切换与权重子集的持久性，其「在相关子目标间循环使切换更高效」的视角可能为 LVR 的轨迹训练、latent 状态特化与复用、贡献分配等提供类比线索，但与视觉推理无直接关联，需核查其可迁移性。
